name: parkeasy
description: ParkEasy — recherche, comparaison et réservation de places de parking (Angular + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('backend/.env')||require('fs').copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env')" && npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c red,blue "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run serve --prefix frontend"
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run start:prod --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
